desc: Replacing our elegant Wingshooter is the Wingshooter Elite. Built on our new CNCed 1-piece receiver, the Elite’s side-plates are fully hand-engraved, reminiscent of our custom-grade Super Scroll. It carries all of the best features in our over/under line, with single selectable trigger, ejectors and two-tone chromed finish. Add to that laser-cut checkering, solid mid-ribs, pistol grip stock and a white bead and it’s hard to find a classier-looking shotgun for the money.
